claims.head: Turnovers could swing this one
claims.call: The Devils get at least their usual 7.8% of their 5-on-5 chances right after winning the puck.
claims.body: The Red Wings give up more dangerous chances after losing the puck than most, and the Devils pounce.
claims.nums: New Jersey 3rd for chances off turnovers (7.8% of their chances come right after winning the puck) · Detroit 27th for avoiding breakdowns
claims.gist: The Devils pounce on loose pucks, and the Red Wings cough them up.

claims.head: Penalties could cost the Red Wings
claims.call: The Devils’ power play creates at least their usual 8.2 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Devils’ power play is near the top of the league, and the Red Wings’ kill is near the bottom of the league. Every trip to the box hurts the Red Wings more than most.
claims.nums: New Jersey 7th for power play (8.2 expected goals per 60) · Detroit 23rd for penalty kill
claims.gist: The Devils’ power play has a soft target in the Red Wings’ kill.

notes.text: C. Brown is out and has not played this season. He is a top-six forward. A. Mantha has taken his spot beside J. Bratt and J. Hughes.
M. Kasper is out week to week and has missed the last 3 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters.
J. Compher is on injured reserve and has missed the last 2 games.

DET.head: Detroit starts a half-step behind
DET.body: New Jersey has had more of the chances over recent games, Detroit will be without Kasper, and Detroit has home ice. Detroit can tip it if they pounce on loose pucks.
